documentation.description: Estimate the recall and cost of approximate kNN search configurations against a more thorough baseline. Each knn_settings entry reports recall of the baseline's top-k, not of relevance judgments, with a recall_stats distribution and an opt-in recall_histogram. All configurations run against one point-in-time, and the baseline runs first, so took_ms reflects an index it has already warmed while vector_ops does not. A top-level environment block reports the segment layout, field configuration, index version and search.allow_expensive_queries the sweep ran against; its monitor-privileged parts are omitted rather than failing the request.

index.description: A comma-separated list of index names to search

ignore_unavailable.description: Whether specified concrete indices should be ignored when unavailable (missing or closed)

allow_no_indices.description: Whether to allow (1) wildcard index expressions that match no indices and (2) requests where the final resolved set is empty.

expand_wildcards.description: Whether to expand wildcard expression to concrete indices that are open, closed or both.

body.description: The kNN evaluation definition: field, k, exactly one of queries or sample, an optional baseline (default exact:true, gated by search.allow_expensive_queries), knn_settings (visit_percentage for bbq_disk, num_candidates for any type, oversample for quantized types; an inapplicable knob is rejected), optional filter, batching (max_queries_per_batch, max_concurrent_searches) and opt-in output (include_details, include_histogram, include_fidelity, value_tolerance).
